book.name: UQAFIQOO UFAFA
book.title: UQAFIQOO UFAFA Naaru kambiqaaninnainaina Yoohaneena uqafiqoo ufafa.

content: Babiroonia maqusa Anutufa naru taikoo ufafa.

Qinee Yoohaneesa mi ainainausa qafamasee moo qangiroo qafaqiafana. Anutufa narí afeeka firaana amufanoo innaarunaindari maqasaa qumuroofanoo mina areenarafa firaaqoo aiqama maqa maaqasaa areeneenoo kaaqa qamaqinau.

Mifa firaa kari maaqi qimasee nameera qinau. Mifa doo kuridinoo firaa Babiroonia maqusa doo aqufinoo kuridinoo. Mi nakundunaki afaannauqa faqa nimanauqaindi qikairi faqaasauqa faqa ufiniuqa afaanna ufini kai fidiaqaa irafauqa kai maridanoo.

Mi maqusaanaasa nári ummuarirana faiqí anaasee narí deedeepa narí deedeepirana uainna nammariara foora aanaamuru mariasa niminoo innee naaqee qimasoofaqa neeneeusa maridaqa. Maqasaaqaraasa aanaamuru karaambaiqauqa Babiroonia faqa ummuaridaqa naafeeqeeusa maridaqa. Aiqama maaqa maaqa pisinisa uqeeree mariasa Babiroonia maqannaasa kaaqa ainaina moomoo irairaaimarinanoo minannai munnimma moomoo maree mariasa maridaqa.

Mi qanqiroofa miqi qimasoofanoo innaarunaindaraa ufa qinee Yoohaneesa moo iriqiafana. Mifa maaqi qimasee Anutuna ufa irimariasa qimanniminoo qinau. Oo qini qiku qisauku innee mi maqusanakiqari doo aniaqa. Innee sia misa mandoosanaki keeqaaqa miqiqa sia misa nariranaki faqa keeqaaqa.
Mi maqusaanaasa mandainaina fannoo naramuaaqa naramuaaqa inoo oorufiifanoo meerai innaarunai ooru maridanoo. Anutufa misa mandoosana qafaidanoo iridanoo.

Misa inni mandaikamma nimaqoondee kai innee quandaki nári nimiaqa. Misa inni mandaikamannimaqoona akiaqara innee quandaki qaaraikamandee nimiaqa. Misa manda nammari inni nimunara innee quandaki mi kaafanaki kai idaqainna nammarina firaaqoo nimifaqa naaqa.

Babiroonia maqannaasa nári nifaaqa areenarana faqa nári moomoo amiqira ainaina faqa nariqa maraqau. Mi ainainna amana kai innee aupurarana faqa ikifaafau qirana faqa misa nimiaqa. Misa náriara uriqararausee qimariana sia maasa keekoopau maridau. Maasa sia ikifaafau qianauree qimariana akiaqara aupurarana faqa ikifaafau qirana faqa nimiaqa.

Misa miqi qimaria mandainaina akiaqara misa firaaqoo nidafirana faqa namuana faqa aurirana faqa ikifaafau qirana faqa aandaroo narirana faqa aiqama ainaina moodaa kari misa nifaaqa quqasaaqa. Misa mi maqusafa ida qama taikaannoo. Karaambaiqa Anutufa misa ufa irimarifa afeeka uriqararafa marifa maridanoo.

Mi qangiroofa Babiroonia maqusara kaqi qinoo qinau. Maa maqa maaqanasaaqaraa karaambaiqauqa Babiroonia maqusaindaraa mandainaina maree mariasa mi maqusana idaqainna idamuna qafamasee firaaqoo ikiraqeefaranoo.

Misa mi maqusana aupurarana qafamasee rufiasee nianai tatiaqa maridaqa maaqi qimasee faiqiara foora mi maqa maaqana qimamifaranoo. Oo mandainaina, Oo naaquqara ainaina maa firaa afeeka maqusa Babiroonia moodaa faasaana kai ani mandoosana akiaqara kuridi taikaananoo.
Maqasaa pisinisa fasiqauqa faqa mi maqusanara ikiraqaida maaqi qifaranoo, sia mi maqannaasa kafaa maasa amiqira ainaina marasee feefauru qimifaranoo.

Sia kafaa moo fannoo maasa koora faqa siruaa faqa firaa feefauru aqimaria oosana oosana ooniuqa faqa marasee feefauru qimifaranoo. Sia kafaa moo fannoo maasa amiqira qamunna oosana oosana saasaakoona arirana faqa fidika arirana faqa marasee feefauru qimifaranoo. Sia moo fannoo maasa amiqira saqari faqa eereefanta aanainnai auqimaria ainainna faqa firaa feefauru aqimaria saqarinannai auqimaria ainainna faqa booroosannai faqa qainnannai faqa amiqira ooninnai faqa auqimaria ainainna sia kafaa marasee feefauru qimifaranoo.

Sia moo fannoo ooruku oosana oosana faqa amiqimasee afundimaru ainainna faqa makaqa nammari faqa fadameena faqa parauaqa faqa raisa faqa burimakau faqa sipsipa faqa qoosa faqa qoosa rarisee mari karana faqa karabusa ainainira faiqi faqa faiqí nimana faqa sia moo fannoo kaifaa mi ainainausa marasee munnimma qimifaranoo.

Pisinisa imaria fasiqausa Babiroonia maqusara maaqi qimasee qifaranoo. Babiroonia maqannaasa innee niqaararee marifaqa adiafaa imarifaqa maree maria ainainausa doo kukeeqafinoo, ani munnimma moomoo faqa ani adiafaairafa kaaqa qaranasaa marina doo taikeenoo sia kafaa paqurinnaranoo.

Pisinisaiki maria fasiqausa Babiroona maqannaasa amiqira ainaina feefaurumasee minannai firaa munnimma maree marusa mi maqusana aupurarana qafamasee rufiasee nianai tatiaqa marida ikiraqeesee soofaaramaseeqa maaqi qifaranoo.

Oo maa firaa maqusa mandainaina naaquqarafa kambiqanoo maridanoo. Mi maqusafa aanaaseera foora saasaakoona arirana faqa fidika arirana faqa afisirafa koora auqimaria oondana faqa firaa feefauru aqimaria ooniuqa faqa afaaqa auqirafa doo maqee dadi taikafinoo.

Miqi qimaseenoo mi qangiroofa sipa kiateenara maaqi qinau. Aiqama sipa kiateenauqa faqa nári pooskurauqa faqa nári pasindiauqa faqa aiqama ooruku nammari amuaqumau nidaqa ainaini marusa Babiroonia idamuna qafeeqa nianai tatieeqa ikiraqeeqa maaqi qifaranoo. Sia moo maqusa maa firaa maqusa auqu faqaafa miqirafa maridanoo.

Miqi qimaseeqa kookooma afaqa qumaree nikiaqa amoondunna kukupamaseeqa maaqi qifaranoo. Oo mandainaina naaquqarafa firaa maqusa auqu faqaafa kukeeqeenoo. Aiqama sipaki nusa ooruku nammari amuaqumau nusa maa maqusanakinaasa ainaina moomoo nimisaida firaa munnimma maree marunausa doo dauni mi aiqama ainainafa qama taikeenoo.

Mi qangiroofa miqi qimaseenoo quandakufanoo Anutuna aiku asauku Babiroonia maqusara qimanniminau. Innee innaarunai mariasa faqa Anutuna aiku asauku faqa Yisufa niqiqoo fasiqausa faqa Anutuna tamummaqara fasiqauqa faqa innee aiqama asasiaqa. Mi maqusafa inni nári ifa mina akiaqara Anutufa maqee mi maqusana arifanoo kuridinoo asasiaqa.

Miqi qimasoofanoo qangiroo moo amudaanai qimarufa ooni firaatia minannai mi aukuanna maru fasiqanaaseesa sakuma andaana andaana rimariqau. Mi ooninna fooqaa tia rafusu qumareenoo ooruku namariki aranaiqi aqinoo qinau. Mi firaa maqusana auqu faqaana Babiroonia maqusa ooni aqunnana amana kai aqusainanoo kukeeqafinaqa sia kaifaa qafeefaranoo.

Minaki piripunna arimariasa faqa kaqikaa ufireena fuaqee mariasa faqa firaa ufireena kookaanauru fuaqee mariasa faqa aiqama musika fuaqee mariasa faqa sia kaifaa mi maqusanaki qafeefaranoo. Oosana oosana ainaini mariasa misa kukusi mariafa sia kafaa irifaranoo, qaindi afai faqa siammirifaranoo.

Sia minaki qooma qaannoo sia kafaa nimundarana tutuqirafa mariannoo. Babiroonia maqusai pisinisa imarusa faqa aiqama maqannaa pisinisa imarusa faqa urinaaqararausa mariqau. Inni aukainaina maraqa nuasa nariqa unnaqira aukainainannai aiqama maqannaasa nikaruqidaqa.
Anutufa narí aiku asauku fidika faqa narí tamummaqara fasiqauqa fidika faqa aiqama maqasaa kuqimarusa faqa Babiroonia maqusaki paqurunara narirana nimiannoo.
